description: Add an endpoint; its signing secret is generated.

body_mode.description: How the body is built: `template`, `fields`, `raw` or `none`.

extra_fields.description: Extra body fields layered on top of the template's.

fields_encoding.description:
How `fields` mode is sent: `json`, `form` (`x-www-form-urlencoded`) or `multipart`
(`multipart/form-data`, where `file` fields are fetched from their URL when sent).

headers.description: Extra headers layered on top of the template's.

method.description: The HTTP method of each delivery.

name.description: A name for the endpoint, shown in lists and deliveries.

query_params.description: Query parameters added to the URL.

retry_policy.description: When and how often failed deliveries are retried.

template_id.description: The payload template, e.g. `native` (Standard Webhooks JSON) or `slack.incoming_webhook`.

template_mode.description: `linked` follows template updates, `detached` keeps its own copy.

timeout_ms.description: How long to wait for your app's answer, in milliseconds (1000 to 60000).

url.description: Where deliveries are sent; can use templates.

name: sendmock_webhook_endpoint_create
